source_text: Duos hircos; sors Domino et sors emissario. Alter immolatur, alter dimittitur. Utrumque mysterium Christi.
pass_a_gloss: Two goats; lot to-Lord and lot to-emissary. One is-immolated, other is-sent-away. Both mystery of-Christ.
pass_b_english: [[Two goats: one lot for the Lord, one for Azazel >> Bible:Leviticus 16:8]]. One is slain, one sent away. Both are Christ’s mystery.
